mapper.sql: ( s.sjh = abr.sjh OR ( s.sjh ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND abr.sjh ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(s.sjh, '0'), ''), '0') = COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(abr.sjh, '0'), ''), '0') ) )

abr.id, COALESCE( abr.bah, ( SELECT CASE WHEN s.bah ~ '^[0-9]{1,8}$' THEN LPAD(s.bah, 8, '0') ELSE s.bah END FROM mr_statistics s WHERE AND s.bah IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.bah) != '' ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS bah, abr.sjh, abr.box_no AS boxNo, abr.expected_box_no AS expectedBoxNo, abr.status, abr.remark, abr.created_at AS createdAt, abr.updated_at AS updatedAt

where.if: AND ( COALESCE(abr.bah, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(abr.sjh, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(abr.box_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(abr.expected_box_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(abr.status, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(abr.remark, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mr_statistics s WHERE AND COALESCE(s.bah, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) )

AND ( abr.bah ILIKE '%' || #{bah} || '%'
OR ( abr.bah ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(abr.bah, '0'), ''), '0') LIKE '%' || #{bahSearchCode} || '%' )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mr_statistics s WHERE AND ( s.bah ILIKE '%' || #{bah} || '%'
OR ( s.bah ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(s.bah, '0'), ''), '0') LIKE '%' || #{bahSearchCode} || '%' )
) ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM mr_archive_box_record abr
ORDER BY
bah abr.sjh abr.box_no abr.status abr.created_at abr.updated_at
ASC DESC
, abr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM mr_archive_box_record abr WHERE abr.box_no = #{boxNo} ORDER BY abr.sjh, bah, abr.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecords, COUNT(DISTINCT box_no) FILTER ( WHERE box_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(box_no) != '' ) AS totalBoxes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'MISSING') AS missingCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status != 'NORMAL') AS abnormalCount FROM mr_archive_box_record

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT box_no FROM mr_archive_box_record WHERE box_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(box_no) != ''
AND box_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY box_no ) boxes
